scope: Uncommitted Reader recovery backend candidate; build is local, not deployed.

isolation.dotenv: .local/empty.env; passed explicitly to Nuxt CLI; production .env not loaded
isolation.environment: Whitelist: PATH/HOME/TMPDIR inherited; NODE_ENV=production for build, test for Vitest; CI=1; NUXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1; SENTRY_DISABLE_AUTO_UPLOAD=true; SENTRY_TELEMETRY=false; SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN empty; synthetic Supabase URL http://127.0.0.1:9 and synthetic keys; chapter summaries disabled; Vertex disabled. No production credentials passed.
isolation.build_network: Denied fetch, sockets, DNS and native child commands except node/esbuild. Final guard also supports synthetic loopback DNS; build mode still permits no connections.
isolation.suite_network: Only loopback fixture ports registered by server.listen in the same process are permitted; external network and arbitrary local services remain denied.
isolation.suite_execution: Sandbox initially denied loopback listen (EPERM); final suite used approved exec escalation with the network guard still active.
isolation.node_modules: Reused existing backend node_modules symlink; no install or dependency changes.

build.limitations: External telemetry, native metadata commands and source-map upload were blocked, not verified. No built server was started. Build success is not a full static typecheck.

full_suite.failure_classification: Existing missing qa-books EPUB fixtures: 10 ENOENT entries followed by dependent result/chapters undefined assertions. Parser code/tests are unchanged by this candidate; no parser repair attempted.

translation_negative_control.source: Unmodified endpoint before candidate patch; mocked DB/model only. Ninth partial-found/model-mock test added subsequently.

checked: Requested block query remains constrained to path chapter_id; no fallback search across chapters.
Initial auth/translation-limit gate and 403 behavior remain unchanged, before cache/generation.
Cache lookup failure emits retryable errors and exits before pending writes or LLM calls; it is not treated as a cache miss.
Partial unmatched IDs receive non-retryable errors while matched rows keep their original cache/generation path.
Success DTO is unchanged; error reason/retryable fields are optional.
Log payloads retain sample IDs but use database error code instead of raw database message.
Summary counters include partial errors and errorRate cannot exceed 100 for counted successes/errors.
scope_limits: This delta review does not establish complete endpoint authorization correctness.
Existing parse-miss/outer-stream interruption behavior is unchanged; frontend bounded recovery handles omitted results.
Synthetic model mocks prove request accounting and branching, not real model quality/latency.

adverse_setup_runs: Preserved startup DNS denial, fixture DNS denial and sandbox loopback EPERM separately; these are harness/environment failures, not product regressions.
